init.title: Bambu Sender and Bambu Hub
init.description: Upload secret: agents upload sliced files with PUT /api/bambu_sender/upload/<name>.gcode.3mf and the header X-Bambu-Sender-Secret (empty turns uploads off). Hub secret: normally set by app discovery; paste it here otherwise (empty keeps the current one). Recipients: YAML map of person entity to notify service, e.g. person.anna: notify.mobile_app_anna; they are notified only while at home.

error.invalid_hub_secret: The hub rejected this secret or is not reachable.
